title: Resources Manager

The RMG Lead is a critical enabler of delivery excellence. You will own the resource management function end-to-end — ensuring seamless fulfilment of project demands, optimising workforce utilisation, and partnering with leadership to future-proof the organisation's talent supply.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1/ Demand & Supply Management**

a/ Drive real-time visibility into open demands and available talent supply across all practices.

b/ Own the fulfilment lifecycle — from demand intake to deployment — including staffing, backfill, and internal mobility.

c/ Lead weekly and monthly resource review cadences with delivery managers and practice heads.

d/ Work closely with Talent Acquisition to bridge gaps that cannot be covered internally, and ensure SLA adherence on time-to-fill

**2/ Utilisation & Bench Management**

a/ Own billable utilisation targets at the practice and BU level.

b/ Proactively identify bench risks, track ageing, and build action plans to redeploy or upskill idle resources.

c/ Partner with Learning & Development and Practice to align skilling programs to the forward demand pipeline.

d/ Ensure bench employees are engaged, career-pathed, and deployment-ready.

**3/ Workforce Planning & Analytics**

a/ Translate headcount, skills, and project pipeline data into actionable hiring and workforce plans.

b/ Build and maintain dashboards and MIS reports covering utilisation, bench status, demand coverage, attrition, and headcount trends.

c/ Present insights and recommendations to senior leadership on a regular cadence.

**4/ Stakeholder Management**

a/ Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery managers, BU heads, project leads, and HR/TA for all resource-related matters.

b/ Balance competing priorities across stakeholders, negotiate trade-offs transparently, and manage expectations proactively.

c/ Build trust with bench employees by understanding their aspirations and advocating for their growth and transitions.

**5/ Governance, Process & Tools**

a/ Design and continuously refine RMG operating models, workflows, and SLAs.

b/ Ensure data accuracy and hygiene across resource management systems.

c/Champion internal mobility programs and cross-skilling initiatives as strategic levers for demand fulfilment.

* 8–12 years of overall experience with at least 8 years in a Resource Management or Workforce Management role within an
  **500+ employee sized**

* Deep familiarity with IT delivery models (Time & Material, Fixed Price, Managed Services) and their direct impact on resourcing strategy.
* Strong technical acumen and JD-reading and role-matching ability.
* Strong command of resource management and HRMS tools; advanced Excel skills.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to synthesise large workforce datasets into clear, actionable insights.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills — comfortable engaging VP/Director-level stakeholders.
* Track record of designing and executing internal mobility and bench utilisation programs.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate degree preferred; Bachelor's degree in any discipline is required

1/ High-visibility, high-impact position that sits at the crossroads of people strategy and business delivery.

description:
**Human Resources Executive | Zapplr Media Pvt Ltd | Kochi, Kerala (On-site, Monday to Saturday) | Full-time | 0–1 years**

Zapplr is one of South India's fastest-growing influencer marketing agencies, headquartered in Kochi. We run creator-led campaigns across Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu and Kannada markets for brands, film studios, music labels and OTT platforms.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

As our HR Executive, you'll own the day-to-day of everything people-related, from hiring great talent to keeping our team supported, organised and engaged. This is our first dedicated HR role. You won't inherit a rulebook; you'll help write it, with close guidance from leadership.

If you're early in your HR career and want variety, ownership and a front-row seat to how a modern agency is built, read on.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Talent acquisition

- Post and manage job openings across LinkedIn, Naukri and Indeed.

- Source, screen and shortlist candidates, and coordinate interviews.

- Manage the candidate pipeline in a simple tracker and roll out offers.

- Run reference checks and pre-joining formalities.

**Onboarding and people operations**

- Own onboarding so every new joiner has a smooth first week: documents, accounts, tools and induction.

- Track probation with 30/60/90-day check-ins and confirmations.

- Maintain employee records, documentation and HR trackers.

- Handle attendance, leave, payroll inputs and everyday employee queries.

- Manage exit and offboarding formalities, including exit interviews.

**Performance and engagement**

- Coordinate performance reviews: timelines, forms, follow-ups and records.

- Track goals and check-ins, and flag issues to leadership early.

- Run engagement activities, celebrations and team initiatives.

- Be the team's first point of contact on people matters.

**Building the HR function**

- Help draft the employee handbook and core policies (leave, attendance, conduct, POSH) with leadership.

- Create standard templates: offer letters, appointment letters and review forms.

- Help select and set up an HRMS or attendance tool.

- Assist with basic HR compliance, working with our CA and consultants.

- Share a short monthly HR update: open roles, joiners, exits and attendance.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

- A degree in HR, Management, Psychology or a related field (MBA-HR is a plus, not a requirement).

- 0–1 years of experience, or strong internships in HR or recruiting.

- Excellent communication in English and Malayalam (Tamil, Telugu or Kannada a bonus).

- Strong organisation, follow-through and attention to detail.

- Comfort with Google Workspace and Sheets, and a willingness to learn HR tools.

- Discretion and maturity with confidential information.

- A genuine interest in people and in building something from the ground up.

- Able to work from our Kochi office Monday to Saturday.

**NICE TO HAVE**

- Exposure to a startup, agency or media/creative environment.

- Familiarity with ATS platforms or job-board hiring.

- Basic understanding of HR compliance and Indian labour norms.

**YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS**

- Days 1–30: Learn the team and current practices, build the employee database, and take over open hiring.

- Days 31–60: Roll out the onboarding checklist, offer and appointment templates, and attendance and leave tracking.

- Days 61–90: Draft the employee handbook with leadership, run the first review cycle, and share the first monthly HR update.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

- A first-hire role with real ownership and direct access to the founder.

- The chance to build an HR function from scratch as we scale.

- A young, creative, fast-moving team in the influencer marketing space.

- Room to grow into a senior people role over time.

6–10 Years

Jewellery / Retail Sector

Bangalore / Kerala

We are a Strategic Management Consulting Company working with entrepreneurs, promoters, CEOs, and senior leadership teams to improve business performance, strengthen management systems, and drive organizational transformation.

We are seeking an experienced and performance-oriented professional to drive the implementation and execution of management systems, business processes, corporate governance practices, and organizational improvement initiatives across client organizations.

The role involves working closely with business owners, senior management, and departmental heads to ensure effective system implementation, operational execution, interdepartmental coordination, performance monitoring, and accountability for management decisions.

The ideal candidate will possess strong implementation capabilities, commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and the ability to translate management objectives into measurable operational outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Management System Implementation & Execution**

* Lead the implementation and execution of established management systems, business processes, operating procedures, and management practices across client organizations.
* Ensure that approved systems, processes, and standard operating procedures are effectively adopted and consistently followed across departments.
* Work with departmental heads to resolve implementation challenges and address gaps in execution.
* Monitor implementation milestones, identify deviations, and drive corrective actions to ensure timely execution.
* Translate management decisions and business objectives into structured implementation plans with clear responsibilities, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
* Evaluate existing management systems and business processes to identify operational bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Drive process improvements to enhance productivity, cost efficiency, service quality, operational effectiveness, and accountability.

**2. Performance Management & Business Reviews**

* Conduct periodic performance reviews with management and departmental heads to evaluate business and operational performance.
* Review departmental targets, KPIs, productivity, operational efficiency, and progress against agreed objectives.
* Identify performance gaps, underlying issues, and areas requiring management intervention.
* Facilitate performance review meetings and convert discussions into specific action plans.
* Monitor corrective actions and follow up with responsible personnel to ensure timely completion.
* Present performance findings, key concerns, and improvement recommendations to senior management.

**3. Corporate Governance & Management Effectiveness**

* Support the establishment and implementation of corporate governance practices, management frameworks, and accountability mechanisms.
* Assist in defining roles, responsibilities, authority levels, reporting structures, and decision-making processes within client organizations.
* Promote adherence to established policies, procedures, internal controls, and management protocols.
* Facilitate effective communication between promoters, senior management, and departmental heads to strengthen transparency and accountability.
* Identify gaps in governance practices, management oversight, and organizational accountability, and recommend appropriate corrective measures.
* Support structured management review mechanisms to improve decision-making, risk awareness, and organizational effectiveness.

**4. Interdepartmental & Intradepartmental Coordination**

* Plan and conduct interdepartmental and intradepartmental review meetings to improve coordination, accountability, and execution.
* Facilitate discussions between departments to resolve operational issues, dependencies, and communication gaps.
* Ensure clarity on responsibilities, deliverables, timelines, and expected outcomes.
* Follow up on decisions taken during meetings and monitor the completion of agreed actions.
* Strengthen coordination between management and functional teams to improve organizational effectiveness.

* Provide practical recommendations to address operational challenges and improve organizational performance.

* Willingness to work closely with client teams and support implementation requirements as needed.

 **HR Operations \& Executive Assistant**

* Design and build engaging eLearning modules for a range of learning and development initiatives, from onboarding and compliance to leadership and functional skills.

* Apply instructional design principles to turn complex topics into clear, structured, learner\-friendly experiences.
* Administer and maintain our learning management system (LMS365\): manage courses and catalogues, user accounts and permissions, enrolments, learning paths, and certificates.
* Keep the platform healthy and current: handle configuration, routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and coordination with IT and the vendor on issues and updates.

* Manage your own workload across content projects and ongoing platform tasks, balancing priorities and deadlines with limited supervision.

 Must\-have
   

  

* At least three years of relevant experience in eLearning development, instructional design, or learning platform administration, ideally in logistics, technology, HR, or organizational development.
* Hands\-on proficiency with Articulate 360 (Storyline and Rise), with work samples you can share.
* Direct experience administering LMS365 specifically, including user, course, and reporting administration.
* Solid grounding in instructional design and structuring content for adult learners.
* A good eye for graphic design, UI, and UX, and the ability to produce clean, accessible material.
* Strong project, time, and workload management, with a track record of juggling content work and day\-to\-day platform tasks.
* Confident stakeholder management, cross\-functional collaboration, and a service\-minded approach to supporting learners.
* Genuine curiosity and the ability to learn new tools, topics, and systems quickly.
* Professional written and spoken English, since you will work with colleagues across regions.

* Practical experience building or maintaining Workday training content, or familiarity with the Workday platform.
* Knowledge of accessibility standards (such as WCAG) and SCORM or xAPI publishing.
* Exposure to a global or multi\-site organization.

* A steady stream of eLearning modules designed, built, and released on time for the priority L\&D initiatives.

* Content is clear, accessible, on brand, and rarely needs rework after release.
* A more structured, repeatable way of building content and running the platform is in place.
* Learning content is rolled out smoothly and consistently across the relevant regions and teams.
